text: Pre-outcome data gate frozen as protocol v2. Raw fixation CSVs are local-only and explicitly Git-ignored. The initially proposed 8-participant common-item rectangle was infeasible (maximum 5 shared eligible items), discovered before similarity scoring. Replacement preserves 8 participants and 80 trials: two participants per counterbalancing signature, five eligible items per participant in each of two globally assigned item folds. Frozen participants: 1015,1018,1019,1026,1038,1039,1042,1044. Exact participant-item-fold assignments and seeds 20260820-20260823 are recorded in inst/validation/GAZEWEAVE-PROBE-DELAY-CONTROLS.md. Data-only importer/fold audit passes for repeated viewing, probe, delay, combined, early delay, and late delay; no outcome score has yet been fit.
